protocol.calibration: Per-check F2 on dev; FP <= same check at 0.5; grid 0.10..0.90 step 0.05
protocol.selection: Prefer calibrated over focused only if dev FP does not rise and dev (recall, -FP) strictly improves. Otherwise use focused at 0.5.
protocol.limitations: Authored bilingual synthetic data; old test is regression. New holdout fixed before calls, but not externally sourced or independent.
